[Unit]
Description=ai.ubq.fi API gateway
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target
StartLimitIntervalSec=0

[Service]
Type=simple
User=codex
Group=codex
WorkingDirectory=/home/codex/repos/ubiquity/ai.ubq.fi
Environment=DENO_DIR=/home/codex/repos/ubiquity/ai.ubq.fi/.data/deno
Environment=DENO_TIMELINE=production
ExecStart=/bin/sh -c 'set -eu; release=$$(cd -P .data/current && pwd); exec /usr/local/bin/deno run --config="$$release/deno.json" --lock="$$release/deno.lock" --frozen --no-prompt --env-file=.env --unstable-kv --allow-env --allow-net --allow-sys=hostname --allow-read=/home/codex/repos/ubiquity/ai.ubq.fi,/home/codex/.codex --allow-write=/home/codex/repos/ubiquity/ai.ubq.fi/.data,/home/codex/.codex/app-server-control "$$release/scripts/serve-vps.ts"'
Restart=always
RestartSec=5
TimeoutStopSec=180
UMask=0077
NoNewPrivileges=true
# The supervisor dials the Codex app-server control socket at
# ~/.codex/app-server-control/app-server-control.sock, whose real socket lives in a
# hashed directory under /tmp. A private /tmp hides that target (and a bind of the
# directory cannot survive boot ordering), so this unit shares the host /tmp namespace;
# ProtectSystem, ProtectHome and ReadWritePaths still fence its writes.
PrivateTmp=false
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=read-only
ReadWritePaths=/home/codex/repos/ubiquity/ai.ubq.fi/.data

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
